chapter.heading: Proverbs 14
chapter.v: but folly with her own handstears it down .
but he who isdevious in his ways despises him .
but the lips of the wise will preserve them .
but abundant crops come by the strength of the ox .
buta false witness breathes out lies .
butknowledge is easy for a man of understanding .
for there you do not meet words of knowledge .
but the folly of fools is deceiving .
but the upright enjoy acceptance .
and no stranger shares its joy .
but the tent of the upright will flourish .
butits end is the way to death .
andthe end of joy may begrief .
anda good man will be filled with the fruit of his ways .
but the prudent gives thought to his steps .
but a fool is reckless and careless .
and a man of evil devices is hated .
but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
the wicked at the gates of the righteous .
but the rich has many friends .
butblessed is he who is generous to the poor .
Those who devise good meetsteadfast love and faithfulness .
but mere talktends only to poverty .
but the folly of fools brings folly .
but one whobreathes out lies is deceitful .
andhis children will havea refuge .
that one mayturn away from the snares of death .
but without people a prince is ruined .
but he who has a hasty temper exalts folly .
butenvy makesthe bones rot .
but he who is generous to the needy honors him .
butthe righteous finds refuge in his death .
but it makes itself known even in the midst of fools .
but sin is a reproach to any people .
but his wrath falls on one who acts shamefully .

footnotes.footnote: 14:3 Or *In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride*
14:9 Hebrew *but among the upright is acceptance*
14:33 Or *Wisdom rests quietly in the heart of a man of understanding, but makes itself known in the midst of fools*
